name: library-management-tests
description: Root for Library Management client, server, and tests

scripts.test:api: docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --exit-code-from api-tester api-tester mongo-test && docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml down --remove-orphans
scripts.test:api:performance: docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --exit-code-from performance-tester performance-tester backend-e2e mongo-test && docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml down --remove-orphans
scripts.test:component: docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --exit-code-from component-tester component-tester && docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v --remove-orphans
scripts.test:component:fast: docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml up --exit-code-from component-tester component-tester && docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v --remove-orphans
scripts.test:component:watch:build: docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml build component-tester-watch && docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm --service-ports component-tester-watch
scripts.test:e2e: docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --exit-code-from e2e-runner --abort-on-container-exit e2e-runner frontend-e2e backend-e2e mongo-test
scripts.test:e2e:performance: docker-compose --env-file .env.test -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --exit-code-from e2e-runner --abort-on-container-exit e2e-runner frontend-e2e backend-e2e mongo-test -- --spec 'cypress/e2e/performance.cy.ts'
scripts.report:e2e:open: open e2e/cypress/data/reports/index.html || start e2e/cypress/data/reports/index.html || xdg-open e2e/cypress/data/reports/index.html
scripts.test:e2e:report: npm run test:e2e && npm run report:e2e:generate
scripts.test:e2e:full: npm run test:e2e:report && npm run report:e2e:open
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:component && npm run test:e2e:report
scripts.test:quick: npm run test:component:fast && npm run test:e2e:local:report
scripts.test:clean:reports: npm run report:e2e:clean && cd e2e && npm run cy:clean:reports
